# Traceback CLI — Core Reference

Use the Traceback CLI (`traceback`) to interact with Traceback AI test automation, manage workspaces, and run browser/mobile tests from the terminal.

## Authentication & Account

```sh
traceback login           # Opens browser to authenticate
traceback whoami          # Show currently authenticated user
traceback auth status     # Show active session and token details
traceback auth logout     # Clear saved credentials
```

## Global Flags

All commands support the following flags:

- `--json`: Output pure JSON for machine readability and piping into other tools.
- `--ci`: Non-interactive mode (fails immediately if required inputs are missing).
- `--silent`: Suppress all informational output.
- `--debug` / `-d`: Print verbose debug logs.
- `--no-color`: Disable ANSI colored output.

## Workspaces & Configuration

```sh
traceback workspaces      # Switch active workspace
traceback config list     # View all local config values
traceback config set <key> <val> # Update configuration
traceback doctor          # Verify environment, token, and network connectivity
```
